# business-pay: GCP push-subscription worker that applies a completed payment to a filing

Flask service. It takes a payment cloud event on `POST /` from a GCP Pub/Sub push subscription. It marks the matching `filings` row PAID, then either creates a staff review row (continuationIn) or publishes to the filer NATS subject. It also publishes an email message to the emailer NATS subject.

- PAID -> `_get_paid_pdfs`. It attaches Notice of Articles, Certificate of Restoration and the Receipt, in that order, each only if returned. The receipt is attached only if status is CREATED. Subject is 'Confirmation of Filing from the Business Registry'.
- COMPLETED -> `_get_completed_pdfs`. It attaches Notice of Articles and Certificate of Restoration. Subject is 'Restoration Documents from the Business Registry'.
- Fallback subject is 'Notification from the BC Business Registry'.
- Template: `jinja_env.select_template([f'RES-{restoration_type}-{status}.jinja2', f'RES-{status}.jinja2'])`.
- Recipients: `contactPoint.email`, plus the officer email of the first 'Applicant' role per party. They are deduplicated with `set()`, None is filtered, and they are joined with ', '.

- `POST /orgs/{id}/affiliations` needs SYSTEM, STAFF_MANAGE_BUSINESS or PUBLIC_USER. The body is validated against the `affiliation` schema, and `businessIdentifier` must contain at least 1 digit.
  - With query `newBusiness=true` it calls `AffiliationService.create_new_business_affiliation`. This is the name-request path and checks:
    - contact email or phone, unless the user is staff -> `NR_INVALID_CONTACT`
    - name request lookup -> `NR_NOT_FOUND`
    - status in [APPROVED, CONDITIONAL, DRAFT, INPROGRESS] -> else `NR_INVALID_STATUS`
    - applicants present -> `NR_INVALID_APPLICANTS`
    - DRAFT must have a COMPLETED payment -> else `NR_NOT_PAID`
    - CONDITIONAL needs consentFlag in [None, 'R', 'N'] -> else `NR_NOT_APPROVED`

- `getModalData` titles and buttons:
  - `isRejectModal`: title 'Reject Access Request?' or 'Reject Account Creation Request?'; button 'Reject' or 'Yes, Reject Account'.
  - `isOnHoldModal`: title 'Reject or Hold Account Creation Request'; button 'Confirm'.
  - `isMoveToPendingModal`: title 'Move to Pending'; button 'Confirm'.
- `getConfirmModalData`:
  - `isProductApproval && !isRejectModal` -> 'Request has been Approved'.
  - `!isProductApproval && !isRejectModal` -> 'Account has been Approved'.
  - `isRejectModal` -> 'Request has been Rejected' or 'Account has been Rejected'.
  - `isOnHoldModal || isMoveToPendingModal` -> 'Request is On Hold', with the text "An email has been sent to the user...".

export enum NrDisplayStates {
    APPROVED = 'Approved',
    HOLD = 'Pending Staff Review',
    DRAFT = 'Draft',
    REJECTED = 'Rejected',
    CONDITIONAL = 'Conditional Approval',
    REFUND_REQUESTED = 'Cancelled, Refund Requested',
    CANCELLED = 'Cancelled',
    EXPIRED = 'Expired',
    CONSUMED = 'Consumed',
    PROCESSING = 'Processing'
}

- **`getPrimaryAction` label, in order**:
  - EMAIL invite with Pending or Expired -> 'Resend Email'.
  - REQUEST Pending from the current org -> 'Cancel Request'.
  - REQUEST Failed -> 'Remove from list'.
  - Draft filing -> 'Resume Draft'.
  - Approved NR -> `getNrRequestDescription`.
  - NR status in [REJECTED, CONSUMED, CANCELLED, REFUND_REQUESTED] -> 'Remove From Table'.
  - Business status in [AWAITING_REVIEW, REJECTED, PAID, PAID_FE, PENDING, APPROVED] -> 'Open Registration' if `corpType === REGISTRATION`, else 'Open Application'.
  - CHANGE_REQUESTED -> 'Make Changes'.
